title: SDK/API coordinated release preflight: streaming + function-calling + structured-output sample validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket coordinates the preflight checklist, release notes, and cross-team go-to-market actions for the combined SDK + API surface launch that includes streaming responses, function-calling, and structured-output support. Focus areas: sample validation against reference prompts, docs readiness, migration notes, QA matrix for backward compatibility, and stakeholder communications. Goal: shipping coordinated SDK packages and API docs with verified samples and clear rollback/runbook by release date.
acceptance_criteria: All SDKs (py, js, go) publish new minor packages with passing sample tests against staging runtime
Streaming, function-calling, and structured-output examples live in docs and sample repos with CI checks that run against staging endpoints
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal and Security, and staged for Console changelog
Migration guide and compatibility matrix published; deprecation notes (if any) included
Rollout plan with canary percentages and automated fallback policies approved by Platform SRE
tasks: Finalize canonical sample prompt set for streaming+funcall+structured (PRD: Confluence /samples/preflight)
Land SDK changes and publish release candidates to npm/pypi/goreleaser (GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/981)
Add CI job that runs samples end-to-end against staging runtime (GH Actions: .github/workflows/samples-e2e.yml)
Draft release notes and callouts: feature summary, migration steps, known issues, rollback instructions
Coordinate console changelog entry, marketing copy, and in-product ‘What’s new’ card
Obtain security sign-off and add KMS notes for private deployments
Design review for structured-output sample schema and example UI rendering (DES-240)
communication_plan: Week-of release: coordinated announcement in #product-launch + #dev-rel Slack channels
Preflight email to beta customers with sample runner and guidance
Launch day blog post + in-console changelog card
Post-launch webinar for partners and early adopters
Changelog snippet and migration highlights for release notes
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (canary): 1% traffic to runtime-1.22 with feature flags on for internal tenants
Phase 1: 10% traffic for customers who opt-in via console; monitor latency/error budgets for 48h
Phase 2: 50% traffic with automatic fallback to previous model family on SLO breach
Phase 3: full rollout and package final SDK release notes and migration guide
qa_plan: End-to-end sample runner: run canonical prompts for streaming, function-calling, and structured outputs against staging once per commit
Backward compatibility tests: run legacy SDK examples to ensure no breaking API surface changes
Load test: synthetic streaming sessions at 5k concurrent connections to validate connection handling
Regression evals: run 150 prompt eval set to check structured-output fidelity and function invocation accuracy
post_launch_plan: Week 1: daily health check meetings with SRE, SDK, and Runtime leads
Week 2-4: monitor quality metrics; create tickets for any regression >5% on quality signals
30-day: launch retrospective and update rollout runbook with observed failure modes
